risks.title: Interest rate changes and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the 10-K, described as directly affecting net interest income, margin, profitability, and liquidity. The language is repeated and emphasized, with implicit quantified impacts. High-weighted Macro category.

risks.title: Banking sector instability and deposit outflows
risks.score_rationale: The document cites the failure of large regional banks in 2023, leading to loss of confidence, deposit withdrawals, and increased competition. Explicit mention of a special FDIC assessment of $6.3 million. Alarmist language and recent context reinforce severity.

risks.title: Dependence on Puerto Rico's economy
risks.score_rationale: Direct exposure of $297.8 million to the Puerto Rico government, with risks related to fiscal stability and federal funding. The document highlights budgetary uncertainty for 2026. Central position in the report, with recent quantitative data.

risks.title: Disruption of federal funding
risks.score_rationale: The OMB M-25-13 memorandum and its follow-ups temporarily suspended federal aid, affecting key programs such as CDBG-DR. Although suspended, the risk of targeted pauses persists. Cautious but concerning language, with direct link to lending activities.

risks.title: Increased competition from fintechs and neobanks
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions competition from fintechs, digital platforms, and other non-traditional players. Repeatedly positioned as a structural challenge to attract deposits and extend credit. Moderate intensity but digital transformation context increases weighting.

risks.title: Asset prepayment risks
risks.score_rationale: The document explains that prepayments on mortgage-backed securities (MBS) affect interest income, particularly through accelerated amortization of premiums. Well described, but relatively lower impact compared to other risks. Less critical category.

risks.title: ESG and reputational risks
risks.score_rationale: ESG risk is mentioned, but the text notes a regulatory refocusing in the U.S. Language is tempered, with recognition of a rollback in federal initiatives. Secondary position in the document, without recent quantitative data.

ai_positioning.summary: The company FBP does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
